# Video.js 8.24.1

Vendored from the official npm `video.js@8.24.1` distribution (Apache-2.0).
`video.min.js` includes Video.js HTTP Streaming (VHS) for HLS playback.
Files are served with the website, without runtime CDN dependencies.

Source: https://github.com/videojs/video.js/tree/v8.24.1
Streaming source: https://github.com/videojs/http-streaming

To update, download the exact npm tarball, verify its published integrity, and
copy `dist/video.min.js`, `dist/video-js.min.css`, `dist/lang/zh-CN.js` and `LICENSE`. Re-run browser
checks and HLS/progressive playback tests. Keep this version pinned.
